body:
I believe this is a duplicate of #2113. I've been working on a fix lately. Hang on! It is coming up.
Thanks for reporting.

@merryzhou I've tested your case more thoroughly and here is my take:
i) if you remove the `operationId`  from the spec, everything goes smooth
ii) specifying `operationId`   makes it a duplicate entry across the board of operations, which is why it fails. The expanded spec is invalid.
iii) there is indeed a bug, but it is a spec validation bug: generation should have detected the duplicate operationId and failed before generation.

issue.title: Fixes validation of duplicate operationIDs when paths are resolved from $ref's
issue.body:
Analysis of operations to be unique across the board is now performed after $ref resolution, on an expanded version of the spec.
If some $ref errors are encountered before this check, the scope is reduced to locally available operations.

* contributes go-swagger/go-swagger#2137

Signed-off-by: Frederic BIDON <fredbi@yahoo.com>

issue.title: Split files generates inconsistency across commands
issue.body:
## Problem statement
I'm testing the split of a single `swagger.yml` into smaller chunks but I'm getting a not consistent behaviour between validate and generate commands.

No errors found when the validate command is run. Instead, when I execute the generate command I get the following error:
`could not resolve schema: open /go/src/github.com/codebien/definitions.yml: no such file or directory`
The generate command is researching the file into the wrong path.
The expected path is: `/go/src/github.com/codebien/swag/swagger/definitions.yml`

I have created a [repo](https://github.com/codebien/swag) to share the code.

## Swagger specification
This is the main swagger file
```
swagger: '2.0'
info:
  version: 0.0.0
  title: Simple API
paths:
  /foo:
    $ref: 'swagger/paths/foo.yml'
  /bar:
    $ref: 'swagger/paths/bar.yml'
  /nested:
    $ref: 'swagger/paths/nested.yml#/response'
```

## Steps to reproduce
* Download the project
* Execute the validate command
* Execute the generate command

## Environment
swagger version: 0.23.0
go version: docker 0.23.0 (Go 1.14)
